completion_data.completion_summary: Closed the channel-(b) target_root authoring hole (conclusion-stage.md Step 4b now resolves and threads target_root/mode_target), converted meta-builder-agent's silent absent-target_root fallback into a loud status:blocked refusal, discharged skill-meta's stale path-qualification acknowledgment, added a standing task-siting rule distinct from the specs/** artifact-location exemption, and settled the file_scope deploy-path convention question in the schema reference. memory_candidates.content: When a prior research/plan pass claims an agent file has a 'gap' that needs a new resolution step added, re-read the actual agent file text before implementing — it may already have a defensive fallback whose ACTION needs strengthening (e.g. silent-resolve -> loud refusal) rather than a brand-new resolution mechanism. In this case, the dispatch description's framing ('remedy (b) means ADDING a resolution step') was stale against the live agent file, which already extracted and held target_root with a GLOBAL_ROOT fallback; the actual fix was narrowing the fallback's action to a refusal, a much smaller and more precise edit than the originally-framed remedy.

Before concluding that a verify-deploy.sh gate failure (a gate#_run killed at its internal timeout) is a real regression from your own edit, run the underlying check standalone outside the full gate battery. A gate's internal per-check timeout can be marginally tight on a given machine independent of load or edits — validate-state.sh --deep genuinely passed clean when run alone but took just over its gate's 60s budget, explaining an apparently-red deploy result with no connection to the files actually edited. This standalone-reproduction step is cheap evidence for a COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS closure and should be the default diagnostic before assuming a gate failure blocks phase closure.

deploy-headless.sh internally always calls verify-deploy.sh --skip-slow with no --only-gate passthrough, so its own RESULT=landed_verify_clean/red outcome cannot be narrowed by a caller. When a Batch Gate Deferral directive asks a phase to discharge a 'full' verification tier via scoped narrowing but the phase's own required check is the redeploy step itself, treat 'run deploy-headless.sh directly' (unscoped, since it cannot be scoped) as the UNMAPPABLE CRITERION discharge, and scope everything else (task-reference/record-versioning lints, diff-based propagation checks) to the files the phase actually touched instead.
